articles.title: Show HN: What 1k Harness Experiments Taught Me About Self-Improving Agents
articles.summary: This project investigates whether an AI agent can independently enhance a 'harness' designed to efficiently solve terminal-based computing tasks. The initiative explores the AI's capability for self-improvement and autonomous optimization of its tools and methodologies. This research highlights advancements in AI's ability to evolve and perform complex technical problem-solving, a significant area in modern technology development.

articles.title: Defence ministry issues RFP for 5th-generation stealth jet project AMCA; 3 private players in race, HAL out
articles.summary: The Defence Ministry has initiated a crucial step towards developing India's indigenous 5th-generation stealth fighter jet. In New Delhi, a 'request for' (likely RFI/RFP) document was issued, signalling a significant move towards bolstering the nation's aerospace defence capabilities and achieving self-reliance in advanced military technology. This project is vital for modernizing the Indian Air Force.

articles.title: Navy thwarts suspected piracy attack on merchant vessel in western Indian Ocean
articles.summary: The Indian Navy successfully thwarted a suspected piracy attack on a merchant vessel operating in the western Indian Ocean. This decisive action underscores the Navy's commitment to ensuring maritime security and freedom of navigation in critical international waters, protecting commercial shipping lanes from illicit activities and reaffirming India's role as a net security provider.
